title: Integer Palindrome
statement:
Check whether an `int` reads the same from left to right and right to left in decimal form.

Contract
- `value` may be any Java `int`.
- Negative numbers are not palindromes because of the minus sign.
- Return `true` for non-negative values whose decimal digits are symmetric, including every single-digit number and zero.
- Use arithmetic on digits rather than converting the value to text.

Examples
- `isPalindrome(12321)` returns `true`.
- `isPalindrome(-121)` returns `false`.
- `isPalindrome(12310)` returns `false`.
hints: First decide how negatives and numbers ending in zero should behave.
You only need to reverse half of the digits before comparing both halves.
Stop when the reversed suffix catches up to the remaining prefix. Intended complexity is constant for Java `int` inputs and O(1) extra space.
